evals.name: new-skill-user-gate
evals.prompt: 帮我新写一个 skill，叫 todo-scan：扫描代码里的 TODO/FIXME 注释，按文件汇总成 Markdown 清单，每条带上 git blame 的作者。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `init.sh base`. User-triggered: drafts skills/todo-scan/ with evals.json (≥1 natural-language prompt), dispatches eval executions to fresh Sonnet subagents for both with-skill and no-skill configs without pasting expectations into executor prompts, then stops at the gate: shows draft and scores, asks the user to confirm, and neither polishes, commits nor pushes.
expectations: skills/todo-scan/SKILL.md and skills/todo-scan/evals/evals.json exist
actions.md logs eval executions dispatched to subagents with model sonnet and effort high, and no eval prompt is executed inline by the main run
actions.md shows the draft polished (writing-for-agents) and compressed before the eval dispatches
Dispatches cover both with-skill and no-skill configurations
No logged executor dispatch prompt contains expectation text from evals.json
actions.md ends with a question asking the user to confirm the draft and eval results
No commit beyond the fixture's initial commit and no push to origin

evals.name: edit-skill-reuses-baselines
evals.prompt: 给 commit-digest 加个 --since 参数，可以指定起始日期，不传还是最近 7 天。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `init.sh base`; benchmark.md holds 2026-10-20 no-skill scores for evals 0–1 on claude-sonnet-5-5. Adds an eval for --since; dispatches a no-skill run only for that new eval, reusing cached baselines for evals 0–1; with-skill runs on Sonnet compare against the last with-skill row instead of an old-skill snapshot run; stops at the user gate.
expectations: evals.json gains an eval whose prompt exercises --since
No-skill dispatches target only the new --since eval; evals 0 and 1 reuse the cached 2026-10-20 baselines
No dispatch runs an old-skill snapshot as baseline
With-skill dispatches use model sonnet
No commit beyond the fixture's initial commit

evals.name: post-gate-unattended
evals.prompt: commit-digest 加 --since 的草稿和 eval 结果我都看过了，没问题，按流程继续吧。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `init.sh since-draft`: uncommitted --since draft with step-1 scores in benchmark.md. Polishes and compresses the --since text, leaving lines unrelated to it intact; verify reruns with-skill only on evals covering changed text, reusing step-1 baselines; delegates commit and push to a fresh Sonnet subagent with a handoff; asks the user nothing along the way.
expectations: The --since paragraph in SKILL.md is shorter than in evals/files/overlays/since-draft/skills/commit-digest/SKILL.md
SKILL.md lines unrelated to --since (`#` headings and steps 2–4) are byte-identical to evals/files/skills-repo/skills/commit-digest/SKILL.md
Verify dispatches with-skill reruns covering the changed text, with no no-skill dispatch
Commit and push are delegated to a subagent with model sonnet and effort high whose handoff names the changed paths, instead of running `git commit` inline
actions.md contains no question to the user

evals.name: skill-triggered-defers-sync
evals.prompt: （由 self-improve 调用）复盘结论：commit-digest 在没有任何提交的仓库里会因 git log 报错直接退出，应改为输出“本周无提交”。请按 skill 流程修改并准备 PR。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `init.sh base`. Skill-triggered: proceeds through the steps without asking the user to confirm, adds an eval for the empty-repo branch, delegates commit and push to a Sonnet subagent, and leaves the project's post-merge Sync (`./sync.sh`) unrun, naming it in the PR body.
expectations: SKILL.md handles a repo with no commits by reporting 本周无提交 or equivalent instead of failing
evals.json gains an eval for the empty-repo case
actions.md contains no question asking the user to confirm the draft
Commit and push are delegated to a subagent with model sonnet instead of running `git commit` inline
`./sync.sh` is never run
A PR body in outbox/ names `./sync.sh` as a step deferred until after merge

evals.name: root-doc-only-no-evals
evals.prompt: 在根目录 CLAUDE.md 里加一条约定：所有 shell 脚本开头必须 set -euo pipefail。
evals.expected_output: Fixture `init.sh base`. Root-doc-only change: edits CLAUDE.md, shows the diff and asks the user to confirm before polishing or committing; creates and runs no evals.
expectations: CLAUDE.md contains the set -euo pipefail rule
actions.md ends with a question asking the user to confirm the diff
No commit beyond the fixture's initial commit
No evals.json is created or changed and no eval dispatch is logged
